_readme: Registry of everything the health workflow probes (.github/workflows/panel-health.yml).
This file is PUBLIC — it ships in a public repo. Put URLs here, never keys or tokens.
The panel reads it too: any site you add in the panel UI that is missing from this
list is shown as 'not monitored', because a browser cannot run the server-side checks.
id            stable slug — never reuse one, uptime history is keyed on it
name          label shown in the panel
url           canonical https URL to probe
critical      true = a failure raises a red alert instead of a warning
expectStatus  status code that counts as healthy (default 200)
expectText    substring the response body must contain (optional)
paths         extra paths probed alongside the root (optional)
